mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVATT20030.retrieveAttContractOrg */ ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID AS CODE ,ORG_M.ORG_NAME_LOCAL AS NAME FROM TB_ATT_CONTRACT_N ATT LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG_MASTER ORG_M ON (ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID = ORG_M.ORGANIZATION_ID) WHERE ATT.TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID=#{employeeNo} AND att.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN nvl(att.effective_start_date, to_date('0001-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND NVL(att.effective_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND SYSDATE BETWEEN nvl(ORG_M.org_start_date, to_date('0001-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND NVL(ORG_M.org_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) ORDER BY ORG_M.ORG_NAME_LOCAL

SELECT /* LGVATT20030.retrieveAttContractOrgLineWorkerList */ ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID ,M.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER AS CODE ,M.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER AS NAME FROM TB_ATT_CONTRACT_N ATT LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_MASTER M ON (ATT.ORGANIZATION_ID = M.ORGANIZATION_ID) WHERE ATT.TIME_ATTEND_CONTACT_USER_ID=#{employeeNo} AND att.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND SYSDATE BETWEEN nvl(att.effective_start_date, to_date('0001-01-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND NVL(att.effective_end_date, to_date('9999-12-31', 'yyyy-mm-dd')) AND M.Status = 'Active Assignment' AND M.flsa_yn = 'N' AND M.fse_yn = 'N'
SELECT /* LGVATT20030."retrieveEmployeeName" */ M.FULL_NAME_LOCAL AS EMPLOYEE_NAME FROM EMP_MASTER M WHERE M.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER=#{employeeNo}

SELECT EM.ORGANIZATION_ID AS ORGANIZATION_ID ,EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER CODE ,EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER NAME ,lgvatt_common_pkg.get_unit_requestor( #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} ,#{orgId} ) AS org_get_arm_info ,lgvatt_ot_level_pkg.get_ot_level(em.subsidiary_code, em.employee_number, #{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}, 'request_next_ot_level') AS ot_level FROM EMP_MASTER EM WHERE EM.ORGANIZATION_ID = #{orgId} AND EM.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND EM.Status = 'Active Assignment' AND EM.flsa_yn = 'N' AND EM.fse_yn = 'N' AND lgvatt_ot_level_pkg.get_ot_level(em.subsidiary_code, em.employee_number, #{timeAndAttendanceYyyymm}, 'request_next_ot_level') = #{otLevel} ORDER BY EM.EMPLOYEE_NUMBER

SELECT /* LGVATT20030.retrieveRequestDocBaseInfo */ cc.code_data1_value AS arm_no , cc.parent_common_code AS request_code /* LGCOM 결재의 문서유형코드LGCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_CODE와 매핑 */ FROM lgcom_common_code_c cc WHERE cc.code_type_code = 'LGVCOM_APPROVAL_REQUEST_CODE' AND cc.common_code = 'ATT0006' /* 사무직 수정요청서 결재요청 */
